title: Technical Support Executive
description:
We are looking for a Technical Support Executive to handle basic web development tasks and provide technical support to our existing customers.

Responsibilities:

\- Handle basic web development using HTML \& CSS.

\- Support existing customers and resolve their software\-related issues.

\- Assist customers with troubleshooting and technical queries.

\- Coordinate with the technical team when required.

Requirements:

\- Basic knowledge of HTML \& CSS.

\- Good communication and problem\-solving skills.

\- Bengali (Required), Hindi (Required), English (Preferred)

\- Customer\-focused approach.

\- Technical background or relevant experience preferred.

Apply Now — If you have basic web development knowledge and enjoy helping customers, we’d love to hear from you!

Or directly apply on Indeed
